instruction: Could you begin playing the stream at this URL? https://devstreaming-cdn.apple.com/videos/streaming/examples/bipbop_16x9/bipbop_16x9_variant.m3u8
source: https://developer.apple.com/streaming/examples/ - Apple HLS test streams for developers

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task variation using Apple's 16x9 aspect ratio HLS test stream (bipbop_16x9). Uses the existing is_vlc_playing metric with type='url' to verify VLC is streaming the specified URL. No custom functions needed.
metadata.verification: Reuses existing is_vlc_playing metric which checks VLC status XML for the streaming URL. The metric handles HLS streams by checking multiple XML paths for URL information.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: VLC is playing the specified HLS stream URL
Getter (get_vlc_playing_info) correctly extracts VLC status via HTTP interface and saves to XML file
Metric (is_vlc_playing) correctly checks VLC is in 'playing' state AND URL matches the expected value
Expected value handling is correct: metric receives rules dict directly and accesses rule['type'] and rule['url'] properly
Metric handles HLS streams robustly with multiple XML path checks and URL comparison methods (direct match, filename extraction, domain/path comparison)
Edge cases handled: missing XML elements, URL parsing errors with try/except blocks
Complete coverage: verifies both playing state and URL match as required by instruction
No postconfig needed: VLC state is accessible via HTTP interface during playback
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor improvement: Metric could explicitly handle None file path if getter fails (currently would raise exception at file read, which is detectable but less graceful)
